title: kj_follow.cancel checks the submitter against the executor's operator, so kj_exec.Sync.cancel names the executor's operator in a mirrored job's record around the call
goal: kj_follow.cancel takes the operator allowed to cancel (a mirrored job's run_by for the executor's own end of a central cancel, the submitter for kbjob.py cancel), and kj_exec.Sync.cancel no longer rewrites a mirrored record's operator around the call

run: s=open('_tools/kj_exec.py').read(); assert 'def cancel(self, job, local)' not in s

repro_reason: the wrong behaviour needs a mirrored job and a central cancel; the repro reads the workaround the fix removes
